note: Access decisions for the Sprint 6 research catalogue. Excerpts are short quotes of the live terms on the review date. Re-check before any future collection. hosts/productPath are used at runtime by the URL analyser (src/lib/sources/policy.ts): unknown hosts and non-product paths are refused.

sources.name: Briyo Supplements
sources.permissionBasis: Stated by the labels.fyi operator on 2026-09-29 that Briyo is a client-owned/authorized brand. NOT YET VERIFIED: no written permission is on file. Automated analysis and feed import stay refused until a signed assetPermission record (status AUTHORIZED, scope incl. FACTUAL_DATA) exists and permissionVerified is set to true with permissionRecord = its _id.
sources.robots: Product pages allowed for all agents; ClaudeBot and anthropic-ai explicitly welcomed. /cart, /checkout, /account, sorted/filtered collections disallowed.
sources.termsExcerpt: ToS: users "agree not to sell, license, rent, modify, distribute, copy, reproduce, transmit, publicly display…" without permission. Proceeding only on the brand-permission basis above.
sources.collected: One request to the public /products.json feed. No HTML crawling, no images downloaded.

sources.name: FITLIX (retailer)
sources.permissionBasis: FITLIX is a multi-brand supplement retailer, not a manufacturer. On 2026-09-30 the labels.fyi operator confirmed authorization to fetch the FITLIX catalogue (public /products.json). The written authorization is held by the operator; by decision it is not recorded as a Sanity document, so permissionRecord is an operator-attestation reference, not an assetPermission _id. Scope used: FITLIX's own listing data and product URLs. Brand imagery, label artwork and product copy are not collected: a retailer cannot authorise them.
sources.robots: Captured 2026-09-30 (Shopify default): User-agent * allows /products/<handle>, /products.json and /collections/; disallows cart, checkout, orders, account, admin, sorted/filtered collections and /recommendations/products. No crawl-delay. Sitemap: https://fitlix.co.in/sitemap.xml (106 product URLs).
sources.termsExcerpt: Collection on the basis of the operator-confirmed FITLIX authorization (2026-09-30), limited to FITLIX's own listing data: product facts it lists and its product URLs. Brand imagery, label artwork and product copy are out of scope.
sources.collected: 2026-09-30: one request to /products.json → 106 products, 105 UNVERIFIED ingestion candidates, 1 skipped (combo pack), written to research/catalogue/fitlix-2026-09-30.ndjson (gitignored, not imported into Sanity). No images downloaded; no image references or description text kept.
sources.notes: Retailer listing: the seller is FITLIX; each product's brand is Shopify's vendor exactly as reported (e.g. MuscleBlaze, BigMuscles Nutrition, Beastlife), never FITLIX. www.fitlix.co.in is not served (TLS handshake failure / HTTP 409 on 2026-09-30).
